mapper.sql: id, user_id, role, area_province_code, status, application_note, decision_note, decided_by, decided_at, granted_at, review_due_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_trust_roles (id, user_id, role, area_province_code, status, application_note, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{areaProvinceCode}, #{status}, #{applicationNote}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, role, area_province_code) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, application_note = EXCLUDED.application_note, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at WHERE user_trust_roles.status IN ('REJECTED', 'REVOKED')
mapper.update: UPDATE user_trust_roles SET status = #{status}, decided_by = #{decidedBy}, decided_at = NOW(), decision_note = #{decisionNote}, granted_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'APPROVED' THEN NOW() ELSE granted_at END, review_due_at = #{reviewDueAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM user_trust_roles WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT FROM user_trust_roles WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY granted_at DESC
SELECT FROM user_trust_roles WHERE status = 'APPROVED' AND review_due_at IS NOT NULL AND review_due_at <= NOW() ORDER BY review_due_at LIMIT #{limit}
